title: The Art of the Deal — Integrative Negotiation & Relationship Capital
tagline: Don't get swept away by a poor deal — pivot against the current.
summary: Strategic success relies on expanding the pie through integrative bargaining. Unlike win-lose distributive bargaining, this approach uncovers shared and differing interests to create lasting value and relationship capital.

learningObjectives.statement: Analyze a negotiation by building rapport first and determining your Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement (BATNA).
Apply active-listening paraphrase and present Multiple Equivalent Simultaneous Offers (MESOs) to surface a counterpart's true preferences.
Apply a counter-anchoring move that neutralizes an aggressive opening anchor by compelling the counterpart to justify their figure.

activities.title: Humanizing the deal; what a strong BATNA buys you
Map your BATNA and reservation point for a live scenario
Present 3 MESOs and read the counterpart's reaction
The 'how did you arrive at that value?' move
Neutralize an aggressive anchor against the Apex Mentor

assessments.method: Submit a BATNA + reservation-point map for a provided scenario
assessments.successCriteria: BATNA is concrete and a defensible reservation point is stated.

assessments.method: Recorded or transcribed role-play negotiation with the mentor or a peer
assessments.successCriteria: Demonstrates at least one paraphrase, one MESO set, and one counter-anchor move.

assessments.method: Written reflection identifying the anchor and the neutralizing response used
assessments.successCriteria: Correctly labels the anchor and explains why the counter-move forced justification.
